claims.explanation: Parachlorophenol is a phenolic antiseptic that kills cells through nonspecific membrane disruption and oxidative stress rather than a single protein target, so selectivity is likely driven by how well each line detoxifies or tolerates electrophilic/oxidative stress. Lines with intact KEAP1-NRF2 antioxidant signaling and high glutathione/phase-II detoxification capacity would be protected, while loss of KEAP1, NFE2L2 activation, or defects in DNA-repair/redox genes would sensitize. The observed enrichment of TP53 and RAS/BRAF pathway mutations in sensitive lines is consistent with impaired stress-response and apoptotic priming rather than a specific oncogene addiction.

features.basis: Loss of KEAP1-mediated NRF2 degradation impairs antioxidant adaptation to phenolic oxidative stress; KEAP1-mutant lines (NCIH1623, HEC265, MFE319) appear in sensitive/least-affected sets inconsistentl
Constitutive NRF2 activation raises glutathione and phase-II enzymes, buffering parachlorophenol-induced oxidative damage
p53 loss impairs DNA-damage and oxidative-stress checkpoint/apoptosis, and TP53 mutation is near-universal among the most-killed lines
Loss of p16/p14ARF removes cell-cycle and apoptotic safeguards, enriched in sensitive lines (NCIH1623, YD10B, KELLY, HARA, OV7)
Oncogenic KRAS raises basal ROS and metabolic stress, lowering the threshold for phenolic cytotoxicity; enriched in sensitive lines (TCCPAN2, CL11, CAL62, OV7)
BRAF-mutant lines (AM38, OV90, SNUC5) are among the most killed, consistent with MAPK-driven oxidative stress vulnerability
ALK-altered lines (NCIH2452, KELLY, SKNSH) appear in the sensitive set, possibly reflecting fusion-driven redox imbalance
SWI/SNF loss reduces transcriptional stress responses; SMARCA4-mutant lines (SKNSH, OV7) are sensitive
ARID1A-mutant lines are enriched among least-affected (MDAMB175VII, CCLFPEDS0003T, BT474, MDAMB361, MFE319, HEC265), suggesting SWI/SNF-intact chromatin states may be more vulnerable
PTEN loss elevates PI3K/AKT-driven ROS; PTEN-mutant lines (H4, TE4) are sensitive, though BT549 is resistant
LKB1 loss impairs AMPK-mediated metabolic/redox homeostasis; STK11-mutant lines (NCIH1623, TE4) are sensitive
NF1 loss hyperactivates RAS-MAPK and raises ROS; NF1-mutant BICR6 is sensitive, though some NF1-mutant breast lines are resistant
